description: This file defines a benchmark class 'MegaGraphBenchmark' that assesses the performance of Orleans serialization for large object graphs, specifically serializing and deserializing a large dictionary with 250,000 entries. It includes static initialization of the test data, setup of serialization services, and benchmark methods for serialize/deserialize operations.

classes.name: MegaGraphBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for measuring Orleans serialization performance on large object graphs, specifically a dictionary of 250,000 string-integer pairs. It sets up the test data and serialization services, and provides methods for serialization and deserialization tests.

methods.name: MegaGraphBenchmark
methods.description: Static constructor that initializes the large dictionary, configures serialization services, serializes the data into a byte array for benchmarking.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Benchmark method to measure deserialization time of the serialized byte array.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Benchmark method to measure serialization time of the large dictionary.
